title: Delta-proxy observer with rate-fence for nonintrusive shadowing
creator: Priya Shah
description: Implement a lightweight 'delta-proxy' observer that duplicates only the minimal request footprint to shadow targets, combined with a per-tenant rate-fence and credit accounting to bound cost and isolation risk. This ticket covers design, PoC, and initial rollout plan for the observer and the quota/crediting components needed for safe mirroring at scale.
background: Current mirror implementations duplicate full requests and responses and rely on bulk sampling to control cost. That causes unnecessary GPU work (full KV cache fills, repeated decoding) and increases risk for noisy tenants. We need a less intrusive observer that reduces duplication volume and ties sandboxed shadowing to tenant budgets while preserving fidelity for model regression detection.
goals: Provide nonintrusive shadowing that avoids full duplicate execution when possible
Guarantee per-tenant cost isolation with enforceable rate-fence and credit accounting
Support stratified sampling for targetted signal (latency-sensitive, high-confidence prompts)
Integrate observability and SLOs for both production and shadow paths
proposed_approach: Delta-proxy: intercept requests at the gateway, compute a lightweight delta (headers, input-length / prefixes, cache keys) and decide whether to forward full payload or a delta hint to the shadow pool
Two-tier sampling: (1) conservative deterministic sampling for high-risk tenants, (2) reservoir-based adaptive sampling shaped by credit balances and signal needs
Per-tenant credit ledger: tenants pre-allocate shadow credits (or default free tier), credits consumed by forwarded work; an enforcement layer aborts mirror forwarding when credits exhausted
Safe execution sandbox: shadow requests use isolated GPU pools with disabled external side-effects and limited timeouts; results logged to an isolated bucket for eval tooling
design_decisions: Carry forward only KV-cache-affecting tokens to shadow when a match is found; otherwise forward full input — reduces duplicate work for repeated prefixes
Make sampling deterministic per-tenant + per-hour window for reproducible analysis across runs
Credit decay: unused credits decay monthly to simplify accounting and avoid build-up
Expose per-tenant shadow budget and recent consumption in Console to enable ops and customers to monitor usage
tradeoffs: Delta-proxy reduces duplicate GPU work but increases gateway CPU and introduces complexity in cache-key derivation
Deterministic sampling improves reproducibility but can miss rare transient regressions unless paired with occasional reservoir sampling bursts
Per-tenant credits add operational surface (billing/alerts) but are necessary to prevent noisy tenant cost exposure
tasks: Spec: write design doc with sequence diagrams and failure modes (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ML/Delta+Proxy+Observer)
PoC: implement delta-proxy sketch in api-gateway (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/3421)
Ledger: implement per-tenant credit ledger and enforcement middleware (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/118)
Sandbox: provision isolated shadow GPU pool and disable external calls in shadow runtime (infra ticket: INF-781)
Telemetry: add metrics (mirror_forward_count, mirror_forward_cost_estimate, tenant_credit_balance) and dashboards (Grafana: /d/delta-proxy-shadowing)
E2E tests: synthetic traffic harness and chaos tests to validate no-production impact on latency or error rates
Rollout: staged enable for 10 internal tenants -> 50 beta tenants -> full opt-in per tenant
acceptance_criteria: Measured reduction in duplicated GPU token compute >= 60% for repeated-prefix workloads in PoC
No increase in 99th perc latency on production API path (<= baseline + 5ms) during canary
Per-tenant credit enforcement triggers and prevents additional forwarding when budget exhausted
Dashboards show mirror_forward_count and estimated mirror_cost with per-tenant breakdown live
Integration test coverage for gateway fallback when delta computation fails
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only routing of low-volume tenants (1-2 non-critical) for 2 weeks
Canary: enable for 10 beta customers with monitoring and auto-fallback to full-copy mirroring if metric regressions detected
Gradual scale: increase to 50 customers and tune reservoir sampling thresholds and credit defaults
General availability: expose per-tenant opt-in in Console and enable programmatic API for credits
rollback_plan: Gateway feature flag to disable delta-proxy instantly (no code rollback required)
Fail-open semantic: if delta computation fails, gateway forwards full request to production only and does not mirror
If production latency regressions occur, flip global feature flag and revert to previous sampling path
If cost accounting inconsistency found, disable all mirroring and trigger incident runbook
